ValidationRule.description: This rule is fired when value of status is not changed from New , Validated , Assigned , On Hold - Internal and On Hold - Customer to "In Progress" .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , ISCHANGED( Status ) ,NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "New") , ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Validated"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Assigned"),ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "On Hold - Internal") , ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "On Hold - Customer") )), ISPICKVAL( Status, "In Progress") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: In Progress can be changed from New , Validated , Assigned , On Hold - Internal and On Hold - Customer.
